# telnyx_sim_card_group_actions (Data Source)

The asynchronous actions on SIM card groups.

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_sim_card_group_id` (String)
- `filter_status` (String) One of `completed`, `failed`, `in-progress`.
- `filter_type` (String) One of `remove_private_wireless_gateway`, `remove_wireless_blocklist`, `set_private_wireless_gateway`, `set_wireless_blocklist`.
